name: Token count
description: An estimate of how many tokens Claude reads for the open file, in the status bar next to its words and characters, and limits for the files agents load at startup (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, ME.md, skills): amber near one, red and marked in the file tree over it. Other files have a limit only when you set one, and the Agent context panel lists what each loads with its imports. Counted on this device, without Claude's tokenizer. Only warns: nothing stops a file from growing.

limit.label: Limit for any file
limit.description: tokens any other Markdown file may have before it's flagged; 0: no limit. A file's own max_tokens wins

limits.label: Limits for agent files
limits.description: tokens by file name (CLAUDE.md, in any folder) or vault path (.claude/skills/**), merged over these; 0 turns one off
